newsitem.title: UK: GEC's outgoing exec may get payoff - paper.
newsitem.headline: GEC's outgoing exec may get payoff - paper.

text.p: David Newlands, who resigned as finance director for General Electric Co Plc on Thursday, may be eligible for a termination payment of more than a year's salary, the Daily Telegraph said on Friday.
The paper said Newlands earned a basis salary of 365,000 and total pay of 480,000 in the year ended March 1996, the last year for which GEC has issued formal accounts.
It said accounts show he also owns 142,000 share options showing paper profits of 190,000, the paper said. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 5106
